advice.actionNotForecastable.do: Remove that rule or make it an ordinary skill rule.
advice.actionNotForecastable.why: The Hydra strategy uses "decide by current trial", a Chimera-only action the Hydra forecast does not support.
advice.cancelled.why: The run was cancelled (the takeover stopped).
advice.capture.do: If the game or the tool was just updated, close the game completely and open it again.
advice.capture.why: The in-game module did not provide this battle's opening data{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}.
advice.conditionNotForecastable.do: Update to 1.1.1 or later; on older versions remove the condition or use a turn condition.
advice.conditionNotForecastable.why: A rule uses a condition the opening forecast does not support{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}} (1.1.0 and earlier did not support "current damage ≥").
advice.conversionFailed.do: If the game was updated after this opening, pick a newer one; otherwise the next battle is captured again.
advice.conversionFailed.why: The opening data could not be converted for the offline engine ({detail}).
advice.damageThreshold.do: This is occasional; if it happens often, change the threshold or use a turn condition.
advice.damageThreshold.why: The forecast's damage landed right at a rule's "current damage ≥" threshold; the live counter's rounding could make that rule fire at a different moment.
advice.engineCopyFailed.do: Check free disk space and that antivirus software is not blocking the tool's data folder, then restart the tool.
advice.engineCopyFailed.why: Copying the offline engine files failed ({detail}).
advice.engineFailed.do: If the game was just updated, restart the game and then the tool; otherwise the next battle retries automatically.
advice.engineFailed.why: The offline engine failed or stopped early; this battle has no result.
advice.fileError.do: Check free disk space and the data folder's permissions, then retry.
advice.fileError.why: Reading or writing a data file failed ({detail}).
advice.gameNotFound.do: Open the game and log in, then try again.
advice.gameNotFound.why: The game installation was not found ({detail}).
advice.inconsistentData.do: This is occasional; the next battle runs again.
advice.inconsistentData.why: The offline engine read inconsistent battle data{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}; the result is not reliable.
advice.liveDiffers.do: Do not act in the game by hand during a takeover, and restart the takeover after changing the strategy. It can also happen in the first battle after a game update.
advice.liveDiffers.why: Turns already played differ from the forecast{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}; it can no longer be trusted.
advice.noLiveWindows.do: This is occasional; nothing to do.
advice.noLiveWindows.why: When the run finished there was no live turn to verify it against.
advice.noMatchingRule.do: Give every champion a fallback rule without conditions (for example A1 on the lowest-health {boss, select, hydra {head} other {target}}) or relax that champion's conditions. Simulate the latest opening in Strategy Simulation to see where it stops.
advice.noMatchingRule.why: At some turn the acting champion had no rule giving a usable skill; a live takeover would pause there too.
advice.noRules.do: Add at least one rule for every champion.
advice.noRules.why: The strategy group has no rules.
advice.notOpening.do: Start the takeover on the preparation screen, then start the battle.
advice.notOpening.why: This battle was not taken over from its first turn; the opening forecast needs the battle from the start.
advice.openingInvalid.do: Restart the game and try again.
advice.openingInvalid.why: This battle's opening data failed verification{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}; skipped to avoid a wrong forecast.
advice.openingMarkDiffers.do: Usually the game was just updated or this battle's data was unusual; the next battle runs again.
advice.openingMarkDiffers.why: The forecast's first devour mark landed on a different champion than in the live battle.
advice.openingWindowPassed.do: Start the takeover on the preparation screen, not during the battle.
advice.openingWindowPassed.why: The battle was already past its first action when the opening data arrived.
advice.policyEvaluationFailed.why: The tool hit an internal error while evaluating the rules{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}.
advice.policyStopped.do: Simulate the latest opening in Strategy Simulation; the report shows where and why it stopped.
advice.policyStopped.why: The strategy stopped during the forecast{hasDetail, select, true { ({detail})} other {}}.
advice.probeMissing.do: Download the complete tool package again.
advice.probeMissing.why: The offline engine is missing from the tool package.
advice.report: If it keeps happening, report it on Discord with the logs from the data folder's logs directory.
advice.reportOnly: If it keeps happening, report it on Discord with the logs from the data folder's logs directory.
advice.ruleCommandNotLegal.do: Check the skill and target of the rules involved ({boss, select, hydra {does the exposed neck or the ally in that slot exist at that moment?} other {does the chosen target exist at that moment?}}). Simulate once in Strategy Simulation to see which rule it was.
advice.stallReport.do: Open this battle's simulation report: it shows the champion that got stuck, its skills at that moment and why each rule did not act. Give that champion a rule it can use (for example A1 without conditions) or relax its conditions.
advice.ruleCommandNotLegal.why: A rule chose a skill or target that was not usable at that moment (on cooldown, target missing and so on).
advice.setupFailed.do: Make sure the game is running, restart the tool and try again.
advice.setupFailed.why: The offline engine could not be prepared ({detail}).
advice.staticDataMissing.do: Open the game and reach the main screen once so it downloads its data, then try again.
advice.staticDataMissing.why: The game's local static data cache was not found.
advice.strategyTree.do: Rebuild the strategy as a rule list and save it.
advice.strategyTree.why: The strategy uses the old flowchart format.
advice.timeout.do: Close programs that use a lot of CPU (including running strategy simulations) and try again.
advice.timeout.why: The offline run exceeded its time limit, usually because the computer was busy.
advice.unfinished.do: Simulate the latest opening in Strategy Simulation for details.
